outcome: Prolongation of pregnancy up to 34 weeks and 37 weeks
cohort: Pregnant women with spontaneous preterm labor between 24 and 32 weeks of gestation who were treated with indomethacin or nifedipine between January 2017 and June 2020.
finding: Nifedipine was superior to indomethacin in delaying preterm labor by 48 hours, increasing gestational age at birth, and decreasing preterm delivery rates.
